name_note: GTDB divides the classical genus Dorea into several genera, of which Dorea_D is one, so published findings on Dorea may include lineages now placed elsewhere.

sentences.text: The genus Dorea was proposed for gram-positively staining, obligately anaerobic, non-spore-forming, rod-shaped bacteria isolated from human faeces.
Its founding strains were members of the Clostridium coccoides ribosomal RNA group, and Eubacterium formicigenerans was transferred into the genus as Dorea formicigenerans.
A study reported the relative abundance of Dorea to be positively associated with central diastolic blood pressure.
Another study reported Dorea to be more abundant in adults with chronic subdural hematoma, and positively associated with diabetes.
